project.name: SASTRE DSL
project.description: A tool for creating clothing patterns using a domain-specific language, with geometric representation and SVG export
project.coordinate_system: Y-up internally (Cartesian), Y-down at SVG render via svgY = viewBoxHeight - internalY
project.build_order: vertical slices: each increment produces verifiable SVG

phases.title: VS-01: Foundations
phases.description: Project setup: TypeScript, Vitest, ESLint, directory structure, testing utilities, npm scripts, README, .gitignore

phases.title: VS-02: First SVG — Rectangle
phases.description: Core geometry (Point, Vector, Line, Segment), SVG renderer (Renderer, Elements), first visual verification: a valid SVG rectangle

phases.title: VS-03: Extended Geometry
phases.description: Bezier curves, Circle, Arc, Polygon, Path, Transform, Measure, curve intersections — richer geometry primitives

phases.title: VS-04: First DSL — End-to-End
phases.description: Lexer, Parser, AST, Pratt, Interpreter, Units, Errors — DSL v0.1 creates geometry and exports SVG

phases.title: VS-05: Parametric DSL
phases.description: INPUT, LET, expressions, point methods (.UP, .DOWN, .LEFT, .RIGHT) — changing INPUT changes SVG

phases.title: VS-06: Pattern Piece Model
phases.description: Model entities (GeometryEntity, PointEntity, CurveEntity, PathEntity), Registry, DAG, Piece model, SVG ModelRenderer — first pattern piece in SVG

phases.title: VS-07: Pattern Operations
phases.description: Offset, SeamAllowance, Notch, Grainline, Dart, PatternRenderer — pattern piece with seam allowance, notches, grainline in SVG

phases.title: VS-08: CLI
phases.description: CLI entry point, build/validate/inspect commands — terminal interface for the tool

phases.title: VS-09: Boxer Pattern Tests
phases.description: Progressive reference patterns: rectangle → polygon → curves → simple piece → boxer front → back → waistband → complete boxer

phases.title: VS-10: Integration Tests + Documentation
phases.description: Geometry→SVG, DSL→Geometry, DSL→SVG end-to-end tests, property-based tests, architecture/syntax/geometry docs, agent guide

tasks.title: Implement Bezier cubic

decisions.title: Hand-written recursive descent + Pratt for expressions
SVG: template-literal string building + optional SVGO
Units: explicit in DSL, internal mm (JS number / IEEE-754 binary64)
AST: discriminated unions with source spans
Y-up internally, Y-down at SVG render
Immutable entity model with append-only Registry
Testing: unit + integration + reference patterns + property-based
